evidence: Tier 1 (executed differential, oracle-generated): the unmodified product-sdk libOpenMS (Debug, core 4fdec46; installed FeatureOverlapFilter.h equal to the pin; PROCESSING/FEATURE, KERNEL and DATASTRUCTURES unchanged between 4fdec46 and bc9cc12 per the C2 manifest) ran 78 cases in separate processes, twice, byte-identical. tests/feature_overlap_filter.rs replays each through the port and compares every callback invocation in order (16,917), every output feature bit for bit (position, intensity, quality, charge, unique ID, meta values, hulls, subordinate hulls) and the map-level fields; the six C++ exceptions are matched to the port's error classes with the map unchanged. Tier 2 (executed probes): the pinned bc9cc12 FeatureOverlapFilter.cpp and extern/Quadtree compiled with -DNDEBUG equal the library byte for byte on all 74 completed cases and give the Release result for three of the four cases the Debug library aborts on, which the port matches; the fourth (a hull-less feature in the hull mode) is refused natively. The pinned quadtree header replays bit for bit on the grid and NaN scenarios. The C2 facts (../oracle/featurefinder-picked/results/omp1/faims_facts.jsonl) are asserted as literals. Tier 3: the 14 FeatureOverlapFilter_test.cpp sections transcribed unchanged. Tier 4: atomicity after merges (including a survivor that changed every journaled field several times), callbacks and failures, refusals, the equality of create_faims_merge_callback with merge_overlapping_features, and unit tests bounding the rollback journal to one entry per field per feature (2,000 co-located features merged into one; 500 crafted FAIMS features carrying merged_centroid_IMs). Six deliberate mutations of the port (child query order, centroid box float rounding, extent float rounding, zero-extent hull boxes in the extent, deleting the skip of a trace whose rt_min exceeds its rt_max, journaling every change instead of each field's first) were each caught by the tests and reverted. FaimsMergeFidelity::Corrected has no C++ oracle, because the C++ FeatureFinderCentroided exits 8 before the merge on every FAIMS input (CPP-278): it is pinned against the specification derived from the source's own parameter documentation (docs/FEATURE_OVERLAP_FILTER_SUPPORT.md, 'The corrected FAIMS merge') and against hand-derived cases written beside the executed c2_* cases they depart from.

cpp_issue_candidates: mergeFAIMSFeatures on features without unique IDs removes every FAIMS feature: removal is keyed by getUniqueId (FeatureOverlapFilter.cpp:269-281; oracle c2_uid0_wipe, C2 faims_facts)

filter does not skip already removed candidates: a removed feature is merged into a later survivor again and its intensity counted twice; a mergeFAIMSFeatures survivor absorbs at most one feature (oracle c2_three_cvs: 1000/900/800 -> 1900/1700)

float quadtree boxes with strict intersection precede the inclusive double tolerance test: a zero tolerance, a tolerance below the float spacing, or coordinates near 2^24 never merge features within the tolerances (oracle bound_zero_tolerance, bound_tiny_tolerance, bound_float_collapse_rt)

getFeatureBounds takes a trace's RT end from the end of the hull outline, which returns to the first scan, so trace-level overlap compares start times only (FeatureOverlapFilter.cpp:69-83; oracle edge_trace_bounds_collapse_trace versus edge_trace_bounds_collapse_hull)

FeatureMap::updateRanges skips zero-width hull boxes (DBoundingBox::isEmpty), so the quadtree extent can exclude a feature's box and a Debug build aborts on a valid map; a feature without a hull aborts the same way in the hull modes (oracle edge_zero_extent_hull_outside_margin, edge_hull_less_convex_hull, library exit 134)

exception safety: filter throws MissingInformation after sorting the map; an exception in the mergeFAIMSFeatures callback leaves the caller's map holding moved-from features without metadata (oracle edge_trace_missing_sub_hull, edge_faims_cv_empty)

undefined behaviour on reachable inputs (source review, not executed): tracesOverlap dereferences std::map::end() for a feature without trace bounds; getFeatureBounds indexes past the hull vector when a feature has more subordinates than hulls; (double) on a string FAIMS_CV reads the wrong union member
